```{mermaid}
    A[Data acquisition<br/>Download Quijote snapshot - HDF5] --> B[analyze_snapshot.py<br/>Stage 1: Stream, crop, stride and target count<br/>Write NDfield - rebased crop]
    B --> C[delaunay_3D<br/>Build Delaunay NDnet<br/>DTFE density]
    C --> D[mse<br/>Persistence - nsig/cut<br/>Dump manifolds - walls<br/>Dump arcs - filaments]

    E --> F1[ndtopo_stats.py - optional<br/>Match IDs to Delaunay<br/>walls/filaments/walls_not_filaments/filaments_not_walls/shared_walls_filaments/shared_filaments_filament_manifolds/unassigned<br/>stats CSV]
    E --> F2[batch_clip.py<br/>Clip slab - axis/origin/thickness<br/>Flatten walls/filaments<br/>Average density<br/>Resample/grid]
    F2 --> G[PNG outputs<br/>2D/3D density, walls, filaments, composite]
    E --> H[batch_crop_and_clip.py<br/>Tile multiple crops/slabs<br/>Runs Stage 1-3 per crop<br/>Runs slab clips per slab]
    H --> I[Per-crop outputs<br/>VTKs, summary stats, topology stats<br/>Per-slab VTKs/PNGs/stats]
```

### Legend
- **analyze_snapshot.py**: Streams/crops/decimates particles; rebases crop for periodic Delaunay; runs `delaunay_3D` and `mse`; exports shifted VTKs (walls/filaments/delaunay) with persistence/smoothing tags.
- **ndtopo_stats.py**: Optional; aggregates Delaunay scalars over walls/filaments/walls_not_filaments/filaments_not_walls/shared_walls_filaments/shared_filaments_filament_manifolds/unassigned (plus filament-manifold variants) into a CSV; accepts VTK or NDnet/NDskl.
- **batch_clip.py**: Clips a slab, flattens walls/filaments, averages/resamples density, writes VTKs and PNGs.
- **batch_crop_and_clip.py**: Tiles the snapshot into crops, runs `analyze_snapshot.py`, `ndtopo_stats.py`, and `batch_clip.py` per crop/slab; organizes outputs by crop/slab.

### Notes
- Walls: descending manifolds (e.g., JE1a); Filaments: arcs (e.g., U).
- Naming: `<prefix>_sX_manifolds_<TAG>_S###.vtu`, `<prefix>_sX_arcs_<TAG>_S###.vtp`, `<prefix>_delaunay_S###.vtu`; unsmoothed conversions use `_S000`.
- Use shifted Delaunay VTKs (non-`_S000`) for slabs to avoid origin offsets.

### Technologies used
- Apple M1 Pro, 16GB, MacOS Tahoe - hardware
- Terminal - interaction with scripts and command line utilities
- Globus - data transfer via CLI
- DisPerSE - Discrete Persistent Structures Extractor
- Paraview - post-processing visualization engine
- VS Code, Positron - IDE for python code development and documentation
- python, pvpython - batch scripting for workflow orchestration, visualization
- Quarto - documentation (markdown)
- mermaid - flowchart generation (markdown)
- Git, Github - version control, public sharing
- ChatGPT-5.2, Codex, Github copilot - learning support, coding assistance
- YouTube - learning resources
